definitions.explanation: Board made by gluing thin sheets of wood together with the grain of each layer at right angles, used in building and furniture.

examples.japanese: {合板|ごうはん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a shelf out of plywood.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{天板|てんいた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{合板|ごうはん}だ。
examples.english: The top of this desk is plywood.

examples.japanese: {合板|ごうはん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何枚|なんまい}→何枚：08777_nanmai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{貼|は}り{合|あ}わせて→貼り合わせる：28249_hariawaseru⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{反|そ}り→反る：11967_soru⟧にくい。
examples.english: Plywood is made by gluing many thin sheets together, so it is less likely to warp.

notes:
In everyday speech it is often called ベニヤ⟦{板|いた}→板：01792_ita⟧, after the veneer sheets it is made of.

- {構造用|こうぞうよう}{合板|ごうはん}: structural plywood
